summary: Body Intelligence feature E2E verified. Backend: 14/14 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_body_intelligence.py pass against the public preview URL — /api/body/intelligence (auth gating, 9 canonical muscle groups, activation+status, balance_pct with -5%/red penalty, lagging[]), /api/body/trend (8-week array + improvement/streak/rating), /api/body/muscle/{id} (404 for unknown, ideal_range + AI tip + suggested_exercises for each of 9 groups), /api/body/generate-focus-workout (creates workout doc with workout_id, no duplicate exercise_ids — carry-over React-key bug fix verified at backend layer), classification thresholds (>=70 green, 35-69 yellow, <35 red) confirmed by logging 6 sets of bench-press and observing chest jump from red→yellow, workout activation feed verified (4 sets logged ⇒ sets_done>=4 across mapped groups + last_impact.workout_name populated), and the /coach/today-insight DuplicateKey 500 regression is FIXED — second call no longer 500s. Iteration-2 regression suite also still green (28/28). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): demo signin → onboarding (now using new goal-/exp-/freq-/equip-/onboarding-finish testIDs) → tab-body all reachable for the first time. Body screen renders ALL required testIDs: body-screen, body-legend, body-diagram, body-view-toggle, view-front/back/side, overall-balance, muscle-groups-panel + 9/9 group-row-* rows, balance-chart, focus-recommendation, generate-focus-workout-btn. View toggle switches diagram cleanly. Tapping group-row-chest opens muscle-detail-modal with title 'Chest', activation %, ideal range '9–14 sets/week', Apex Coach AI tip card, and 3 suggested exercises (suggested-ex-0 visible). Clicking Generate focus workout fires POST /api/body/generate-focus-workout and navigates to /workout/wkt_* — full integration end-to-end verified. workout-impact section is correctly hidden for fresh user with no completed workouts (as spec'd). One minor backend gap: /api/body/muscle/{id} only returns 1 suggested exercise for 'calves' (library has just calf-raise) and 2 for 'core' instead of the spec'd 3 — main agent should broaden the exercise library or relax spec.

minor.issue: suggested_exercises returns only 1 item (calf-raise) instead of spec'd 3 — EXERCISE_LIBRARY contains only one calves exercise. Either add 2 more (e.g., seated-calf-raise, single-leg-calf-raise) or document that ≤3 may be returned.

Likely returns <3 because cable-crunch's 'Abs' muscle is not in MUSCLE_GROUP_MAP (only 'Core' is). Add 'Abs': 'core' to MUSCLE_GROUP_MAP or include compound lifts (squat/OHP/swing) as fallback suggestions.

issues: Console emits repeating 'Unknown event handler property onResponderGrant/Move/Release/...' warnings from BodyDiagram SVG — RN-web does not implement the touch responder system on raw SVG nodes. Functionally harmless (taps still register via Pressable wrappers) but pollutes console.
Carry-over: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings still present (not new).

react_native_issues.issue: Still pinned at 1.18.6 vs Expo expected 1.18.5. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log (repeats every Metro start).
Deprecated shadow* props in use across components — should migrate to boxShadow for RN-web. Reference: console warnings on every screen render.

action_items: Backend: extend EXERCISE_LIBRARY (or MUSCLE_GROUP_MAP) so /body/muscle/calves and /body/muscle/core return 3 suggested_exercises — currently calves returns 1 and core likely returns 2 because 'Abs' is not mapped to 'core'.

Frontend: BodyDiagram SVG emits onResponder* unknown-handler warnings on web. Wrap touch logic in a Pressable parent (already done for taps) and ensure no responder props are spread onto raw SVG elements when Platform.OS === 'web'.
Carry-over: align react-native-keyboard-controller to 1.18.5 and migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1512 lines — still a single module. After body endpoints, this really needs to be split into routers (auth, plan, workouts, coach, billing, body) before more features land.
/body/generate-focus-workout uses a `seen` set + nested for-loops to avoid duplicate exercise_ids — good, fixes the carry-over React duplicate-key warning. Verified at backend.

/body/muscle/{id} suggestion loop breaks on first match per exercise then checks `if len(suggestions) >= 3`. For sparse groups (calves) this terminates early with fewer than 3. Consider falling back to compound exercises that hit the muscle as secondary, or expanding the library.

/_compute_muscle_activation re-fetches the full EXERCISE_LIBRARY linearly for every set logged — fine at <100 exercises, but build an in-memory dict {id: ex} at module load to keep complexity in check as the library grows.

rca_of_issue: Coach today-insight DuplicateKey 500 (iter-2 carry-over) — RCA: daily_insights collection has a unique index on (user_id, date_str); on the second call within the same day the insert raised DuplicateKeyError. Mitigation now confirmed: server returns 200 with the existing insight (verified by TestCarryoverFixes::test_today_insight_no_500_on_duplicate which calls the endpoint twice and asserts status 200 on the second call).
